item.sophisticatedsmeltery.advanced_sear: Pours manually or automatically, preferring the furnace's bottom fluid before tank upgrades.
item.sophisticatedsmeltery.seared_castin: Uses Tinkers' casting recipes, preferring the furnace's bottom fluid before tank upgrades.
item.sophisticatedsmeltery.scorched_cast: Casts using scorched table or basin rules. Requires a cast; lock it to refill from storage.
item.sophisticatedsmeltery.advanced_scor: Pours manually or automatically using scorched casting rules. Lock a cast to refill from storage.
error.sophisticatedsmeltery.empty_castin: Return remaining casting fluid or finish cooling before removing this upgrade.
gui.sophisticatedsmeltery.cast_mode_lock: Return the fluid or finish cooling before switching modes.
gui.sophisticatedsmeltery.cast_no_contro: Install a melting controller or tank upgrade to pour or return fluid.
gui.sophisticatedsmeltery.cast_output_hi: Storage prefers non-melting slots. The output slot stacks identical items and data, waiting when full.
gui.sophisticatedsmeltery.cast_lock_hint: Remembers this cast's item and data; refills it from storage after use. Click again to unlock.
item.sophisticatedsmeltery.melting_upgra: Melts backpack items using the bound controller's rules.
error.sophisticatedsmeltery.one_controll: Only one melting controller can be installed.
error.sophisticatedsmeltery.bind_control: Bind a supported controller before installing this upgrade.
error.sophisticatedsmeltery.empty_fluids: Empty the furnace and Tinkers fuel tanks before removing the controller.
gui.sophisticatedsmeltery.transfer_hint: Left: tank to furnace. Right: furnace to tank.
